Note: We typically add false inflation alerts on any items that have jumped 300% or more in price compared to our current listed price. We typically only do this for items costing >100,000 NP, or buyable items that have gone unbuyable. For example, an item that goes from 500 NP to 2,000 NP would not receive an alert. But an item that has a consistent history of being around 75,000 NP that sees a sudden jump to say, 250,000 NP, might be worthy of a warning.

These guidelines do not apply to items inflated naturally due to time passing (such as a retired item raising in price over time), or an event occurring (such as Charity Corner pushing up the price of wearables).

The spirit of our inflation warning guidelines is to prevent buyers from being ripped off with prices they shouldn't be paying. So if you think an item qualifies, don't hestitate to let us investigate.
